$comment: Which model ReelMakeEasy uses for each job. Roles point at keys in `models`. Override any role with <ROLE>_MODEL (e.g. VIDEO_FIRSTLAST_MODEL=veo-3.1-fast) or point MODELS_FILE at your own copy. Keys live in .env, never here. Restart after editing. See reelmakeeasy.models.example.json for alternatives. providerRoles.google maps roles to Gemini API models (GEMINI_API_KEY), used when Setup picks Gemini to make pictures, clips, voices and music.

roles.$comment: null disables a role. video.* roles need an endpoint for their mode.

fallbacks.$comment: Models to try, in order, when a role's model fails or can't serve the request. Only models of the current generation provider are tried (fal or google).

beatLoop.$comment: Clip models for loop shorts (4 s clips on a 1-2-3-4 beat, each from the last frame of the one before), tried in order; each runs only when its provider's key is set. Veo is left out: fal's Veo 3.1 Fast missed the beat on every test clip, and Veo on the Gemini API takes a last frame only on 8 s clips.

providerRoles.$comment: Roles used when Gemini (google) makes pictures, clips, voices and music. A role not listed here uses `roles`. null turns that feature off on Gemini. Clips default to Omni Flash: it goes from one keyframe to the next at the length each clip needs (3 to 10 s), while Veo on the Gemini API takes a last frame only on 8 s clips, which then get sped up and cut to fit. The Veo models stay in the clip menu. Captions use Gemini Transcribe, and tts.elevenlabs is null: ElevenLabs voices never run on fal here, only on ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

gpt-image-2.5-flare.$comment: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 Flare. With reference images (keyframes from the anchor sheet) it runs on /edit, which makes a new scene from them. Price follows size and quality: medium (about $0.01 per 9:16 image) is enough for 768p video; high is about $0.04.
gpt-image-2.5-flare.label: GPT Image 2.5 Flare

nano-banana-lite.$comment: Google Nano Banana Lite: fast, cheap pictures for the agent chat's generate_image (Claude chats). Billed by output image tokens ($37.50 per million, about $0.05 a picture). Uses /edit when a reference image is passed; no resolution option.
nano-banana-lite.label: Nano Banana Lite

nano-banana-pro.$comment: Uses /edit when reference images are passed.
nano-banana-pro.label: Nano Banana Pro

minimax-h3-max-turbo.$comment: MiniMax Hailuo 3 Max Turbo. First-last frame runs on image-to-video with end_image_url; clips are whole seconds from 5 to 15 (durationsSec), at 480P, 768P (default) or 1080P. A caller that needs an exact length, like a loop's 4 s clip, can ask for anything from 0.92 to 15 s (durationRangeSec). fal bills the seconds asked for; the clip runs up to about 0.5 s longer (4 s comes back as 4.46 s). Fast enough (about 10 s per clip end to end) to make transitions one after another, each starting from the previous clip's last frame. Prices are fal's regular per-second rates (not launch promotions). frameSizes are the sizes it renders (measured); first and last frames are fitted to them so the model never reframes a mismatched pair.
minimax-h3-max-turbo.label: MiniMax Hailuo 3 Max Turbo

ace-step.$comment: ACE-Step on fal: composes to the video's length (5 s to 4 min) from style tags, with an explicit instrumental mode, so no vocals. $0.0002 per second (a 60 s bed is about $0.01). The owner's pick after comparing CassetteAI and MiniMax Music 2.0.
ace-step.label: ACE-Step

minimax-music-v2.$comment: MiniMax Music 2.0 on fal: a full instrumental arrangement (song tags marked instrumental in place of lyrics), about a minute long, trimmed or looped to the video. $0.03 per piece. Not the default: in the owner's test 8 of 10 pieces had vocals despite the instrumental tags.
minimax-music-v2.label: MiniMax Music 2.0

cassette-music.$comment: CassetteAI on fal: composes a piece to the video's length (10 s to 3 min) for $0.02 per minute of output (a 30 s bed costs $0.01); the cheapest option. No instrumental switch: the BGM director's prompt always ends with 'Instrumental.' Set roles.music to cassette-music to use it.
cassette-music.label: CassetteAI Music

eleven-music.$comment: ElevenLabs Music on fal: composes a piece to the video's length (3 s to 10 min), always instrumental. $0.60 per started minute of output (a 20 s bed costs $0.60), so it is not the default; set roles.music to eleven-music to use it.
eleven-music.label: ElevenLabs Music

lyria2.$comment: Google Lyria 2: one 30 s clip for $0.10, looped to the video (a seam on longer videos); set roles.music to lyria2 to use it.
lyria2.label: Lyria 2

eleven-v3-fal.$comment: ElevenLabs voices without ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: Eleven v3 hosted on fal. With the key, roles.tts is called on ElevenLabs directly.
eleven-v3-fal.label: ElevenLabs v3 (on fal)

elevenlabs-align-fal.$comment: Word timings for a known script without ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
elevenlabs-align-fal.label: ElevenLabs Forced Alignment (on fal)

elevenlabs-scribe-fal.$comment: Caption timing (speech to text) without ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: Scribe v2 on fal, $0.008 per minute of audio.
elevenlabs-scribe-fal.label: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (on fal)

nano-banana-pro-google.$comment: Nano Banana Pro on the Gemini API: keyframes, and edits with reference pictures. $0.134 per 1K or 2K picture, $0.24 at 4K.
nano-banana-pro-google.label: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini)

nano-banana-2-google.$comment: Nano Banana 2 on the Gemini API: the fast tier. $0.067 per 1K picture.
nano-banana-2-google.label: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini)

nano-banana-2-lite-google.$comment: Nano Banana 2 Lite on the Gemini API: agent chat previews. 1K only, about $0.034 a picture.
nano-banana-2-lite-google.label: Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini)

veo-3.1-fast-google.$comment: Veo 3.1 Fast on the Gemini API: offered in the clip menu, and the fallback when Omni Flash fails. 4, 6 or 8 s (clips snap); first-to-last-frame clips are always 8 s, the only length the API takes a last frame for, so a shorter clip is sped up and cut to fit; 1080p only for 8 s clips. Always makes sound, which transitions strip. $0.10/s at 720p, $0.12/s at 1080p.
veo-3.1-fast-google.label: Veo 3.1 Fast (Gemini)

veo-3.1-lite-google.$comment: Veo 3.1 Lite on the Gemini API: the cheapest clips. $0.05/s at 720p, $0.08/s at 1080p.
veo-3.1-lite-google.label: Veo 3.1 Lite (Gemini)

veo-3.1-google.$comment: Veo 3.1 on the Gemini API: the best quality. $0.40/s.
veo-3.1-google.label: Veo 3.1 (Gemini)

omni-flash-google.$comment: Gemini Omni Flash (Interactions API): the default clip model on Gemini. First and last frame as two images at any whole-second length from 3 to 10 s, so each clip is made at its own length (Veo needs 8 s clips for a last frame). 720p; both frames are cropped and scaled to frameSizes first, since Omni crops a mismatched picture itself. Billed in tokens: about $0.104/s, $0.415 for a 4 s clip. Always makes sound, which transitions strip and loops keep.
omni-flash-google.label: Gemini Omni Flash

lyria-3-clip-google.$comment: Lyria 3 Clip on the Gemini API: one 30 s instrumental piece for $0.04, looped to longer videos.
lyria-3-clip-google.label: Lyria 3 Clip (Gemini)

gemini-tts.$comment: Gemini TTS: 30 prebuilt voices (gemini-* presets). About $0.002 per 10 s of speech.
gemini-tts.label: Gemini TTS

gemini-transcribe.$comment: Gemini Transcribe (Interactions API) with word timestamps: caption timing on Gemini without an ElevenLabs key. About $0.005 per minute.
gemini-transcribe.label: Gemini Transcribe
